snippet.title: Helldivers 2 - Attack on Cyberstan Deep Dive
snippet.description:
01010011 01010101 01010000 01000101 01010010 00100000 01001010 01001111 01010010 01000100 01000101 01001110

Due to Automaton threats, all celebratory anniversary activities have been postponed.

Every minute counts as our enemy forges a planet-killing weapon of galactic destruction.

As we close in on Cyberstan, a weak point in their planetary defenses has been identified.

Watch this transmission for further briefing.
